hero.headline:
No Friction.
No Pressure.
hero.sub: We stand behind every device with our 30-Day Ritual Guarantee. If it doesn't work for you, it's on us.

items.title: Request a Return
items.desc: Email us at info@zentialpure.com within 30 days of delivery with your order number.

items.title: Get Approved
items.desc: We'll review and approve your request within 24 hours, no lengthy questionnaires.

items.title: Ship It Back
items.desc: We'll provide a prepaid return label. Pack the device in its original packaging.

items.title: Get Refunded
items.desc: Once received and inspected, your refund is processed within 5 to 7 business days.

items.title: 30-Day Ritual Guarantee
items.desc: If you don't feel visible improvement within 30 days of consistent daily use, contact us for a full refund. We believe in the technology, and we believe in your experience.

items.title: Condition Requirements
items.desc: Devices must be returned in their original packaging and in working condition. Accessories (gels, pads) are non-returnable once opened for hygiene reasons.

items.title: Damaged or Defective Items
items.desc: If your product arrives damaged or defective, contact us immediately. We'll send a replacement at no cost, no return needed.

items.title: Exchanges
items.desc: Want a different color or variant? Contact us within 14 days and we'll arrange an exchange, subject to availability.

cta.headline: Ready to return or need help?
cta.sub: Our team handles every request within 24 hours.
